diagnosis.root_cause: The outer training loop retained the materialized prior gradient tree and v3 telemetry through held-out evaluation, checkpoint publication, and construction of the next step. This overlapped two resident-scale computation lifetimes; MLX wired memory is allocator policy, not a hard whole-process footprint cap.
diagnosis.repair: Delete gradient and telemetry references immediately after optimizer materialization, clear the MLX cache before any holdout/checkpoint/next-step work, clear each held-out graph after scalar extraction, and emit allocator telemetry in each loss window.
diagnosis.durable_checkpoint: step five exists under the old trainer identity and is retained as diagnostic evidence only; CP185 starts from step zero under a new trainer hash
